question: Which divine names must be uttered in this part of the mantra?
premises: One should utter the word Ekajaṭā.
One should utter the word Nīla Sarasvatī.
These are addressed as revered forms.
inference: The mantra requires invoking the revered Ekajaṭā and Nīla Sarasvatī by name.
plain_english: One should utter the words: revered Ekajaṭā, blue Sarasvatī.
